title: MNS leader threatens protest over Diljit Dosanjh concert, seeks ban on large events

ai.summary: MNS leader Dinesh Punde urged Mumbai Police to ban concerts at Mahalaxmi Racecourse and NSCI Dome due to drug sales, traffic issues, and a fatal drug incident, threatening a road blockade if the events continue.

facts.claim: MNS leader Dinesh Dnyaneshwar Punde urged Mumbai Police to impose an immediate ban on live music concerts and large-scale entertainment events at Mahalaxmi Racecourse and the NSCI Dome
Punde cited a recent Anti-Narcotics Cell (ANC) crackdown and a previous fatal drug-related incident at a concert venue to press for a ban
facts.quote: At an event held on November 22, 2026, the ANC took action against 12-13 individuals for drug consumption. Even now, we have not forgotten the incident last year in which a young man lost his life at this very venue due to drug consumption.

facts.claim: Punde warned that the MNS would join local residents in staging protests if the events were allowed to continue
facts.quote: If these concerts are not stopped, the MNS, along with local residents, will stage a Rasta Roko (road blockade) agitation at the location

facts.claim: Mumbai Police deployed a newly launched ANC forensic van outside Mahalaxmi Racecourse to curb drug abuse at large gatherings
facts.quote: Mumbai Police deployed a newly launched ANC forensic van outside Mahalaxmi Racecourse as part of efforts to curb drug abuse at large gatherings.

ai.background_note: MNS leader Dinesh Punde is demanding a ban on concerts at Mahalaxmi Racecourse and NSCI Dome in Mumbai due to drug sales and traffic issues, threatening a road blockade if the events continue.
